pr_body:
## Summary

If we have a singleton `Range`, we don't need to iterate over the map of available ranges; instead, we can just get the singleton directly.

Closes #6131.

issue_context.title: Add fast-path for `select_candidate` with singletons
issue_context.body:
We already know the version, and the version maps are indexed by version. Can we just skip the iterator?

In `echo "apache-airflow[google]" | cargo run pip compile -`, about 4-5% of the calls to `select_candidate` use a singleton.
